description: The bar chart illustrates F1 Score performance (in percent) for three MADLLM model variants across multiple datasets. The horizontal axis contains the dataset categories, shown left to right as an unlabeled/blank category (with a small gray rectangle beneath it), PSM, SWaT, SMAP, and MSL, and the vertical axis is labeled “F1 Score (%)” on a linear scale ranging from 80 to 100 with tick marks at 80, 90, and 100. Each dataset category has a grouped set of three adjacent bars corresponding to the legend at the top: MADLLM (light green), MADLLM w/o feature embedding (lavender), and MADLLM w/o skip embedding (peach). For the leftmost unlabeled category, the bars are approximately 93–94% (green), about 89–90% (lavender), and about 90% (peach). For PSM, the bars are about 97% (green), about 94% (lavender), and about 92–93% (peach). For SWaT, the bars are about 91% (green), about 86% (lavender), and about 86% (peach). For SMAP, the bars are about 93–94% (green), about 90% (lavender), and about 90% (peach). For MSL, the bars are about 92–93% (green), about 89–90% (lavender), and about 89% (peach). The bars are not visually sorted by height; they follow the dataset order on the x-axis, and no individual bars appear specially emphasized beyond the consistent color coding and thin black outlines.
